info.name: Laravel Multitenant SSO Boilerplate
info.description: API collection for the Laravel Multitenant SSO Boilerplate.

Default admin password — matches ADMIN_PASSWORD in .env

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Authentication endpoints.

**API auth** (`/api/login`, `/api/logout`) — stateless Sanctum token flow used by mobile clients and SPAs that manage their own token storage.

**Web auth** (`/login`, `/logout`) — session-based flow for the browser frontend (Inertia.js). After login the server redirects: users with one app go directly to that app's dashboard; users with multiple apps are sent to `/apps` to choose. An idle session timeout (configurable via the `authentication_idle_time` system setting, default 30 min) automatically logs out inactive browser sessions. The web logout endpoint invalidates the session and redirects to `/login`.

Note: web endpoints use Laravel session cookies and require a valid CSRF token (`X-XSRF-TOKEN` header or `_token` form field). They are documented here for reference — use the API endpoints for token-based integrations.

request.description:
Authenticate with email and password. Returns a Bearer token, user info, and accessible apps with their tenants.

Default admin credentials are pre-filled via `admin_email` and `admin_password` collection variables (set from `ADMIN_EMAIL` / `ADMIN_PASSWORD` in your `.env`).

The test script automatically saves the returned token to the `token` collection variable.
Revokes the current Sanctum access token. Requires a valid Bearer token (inherited from collection auth). Use this for token-based (mobile / SPA) clients.

header.description: Required CSRF token. Obtain from the XSRF-TOKEN cookie set by GET /login.

request.description:
Session-based web logout. Invalidates the Laravel session and regenerates the CSRF token, then redirects to `/login`.

Requires an active browser session (session cookie) and a valid CSRF token in the `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header.

This is the endpoint the browser frontend calls — it is not a JSON API and does not use a Bearer token. The response is a `302` redirect to `/login`.
Returns the list of apps and tenants the authenticated user has access to, along with their roles.

item.name: Reports
item.description: Async report generation endpoints. All requests require a Bearer token. The `report_id` collection variable is auto-saved by the 'Dispatch Single Report' test script.

request.description: Returns a paginated list of reports belonging to the authenticated user, ordered by most recent.

Dispatches a single report job to the `reports` Redis queue. Status transitions: `pending → processing → success | failed`.

Valid `format` values: `screen`, `pdf`, `excel`.
Valid `delivery` values: `download`, `email`, `none`.

The test script auto-saves the returned report UUID to the `report_id` collection variable.

response.name: 422 Unprocessable

request.description:
Dispatches up to 50 report jobs as a single Laravel Bus batch. All reports in the batch must share the same `format` and `delivery` values.

On completion, if `delivery` is `download` and multiple reports succeed, a ZIP archive is created and its path stored on the first report record (retrievable via `GET /api/reports/{reports[0].id}/download`).

response.name: 422 Mixed formats

request.description: Returns the current status and result of a report. Poll this endpoint after dispatching until `status` is `success` or `failed`.

Streams the generated report file. Only available when `status` is `success` and a `file_path` is set.

For download-delivery batches the ZIP archive is stored on the first report record — use that report's ID here.
Deletes a report record and its associated file from storage. Owner-only — returns 403 for reports belonging to other users.

item.name: Report Subscriptions
item.description: Per-tenant scheduled report subscriptions. Tenants subscribe to recurring reports (daily / weekly / monthly) delivered via email, S3, or both. All requests require a Bearer token.

request.description: Returns a paginated list of report subscriptions for the current tenant.

Creates a new report subscription for the current tenant.

Valid `frequency` values: `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly`.
Valid `delivery` values: `email`, `s3`, `email_and_s3`.

`recipients` is required when delivery is `email` or `email_and_s3`.
`s3_path` is the S3 key prefix (e.g. `tenant-reports/`) used when delivery is `s3` or `email_and_s3`.

The test script auto-saves the returned ID to the `subscription_id` collection variable.

response.name: 422 Unprocessable

request.description: Returns a single report subscription by ID.

Partially updates a subscription. All fields are optional — only send the ones you want to change.

Use `is_active: false` to pause a subscription without deleting it.
Permanently deletes a subscription. Use `is_active: false` via the update endpoint to pause without deleting.

item.name: Profile (API)
item.description: User self-service profile endpoints — stateless Bearer token auth. All responses use the `UserResource` envelope `{ "data": { ... } }`. Requires a valid Sanctum token (inherited from collection auth).

request.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile wrapped in a `UserResource` envelope.

Updates the authenticated user's display name. Returns the updated `UserResource`.

Validation: required, string, max 255 characters.

response.name: 422 Validation Error

formdata.description: Image file (JPG, PNG, GIF). Max size: 2 MB.

request.description:
Uploads or replaces the authenticated user's profile picture. Returns the updated `UserResource` with a populated `profile_picture_url`.

Validation: required, must be an image (jpg/png/gif/bmp/svg/webp), max 2048 KB (2 MB). The old picture is deleted on replacement.

response.name: 422 Validation Error (not an image)

request.description:
Changes the authenticated user's password. Returns `200` with a success message.

Validation: `current_password` must match the existing password; `password` is required, confirmed, and at least 8 characters.

response.name: 422 Validation Error (wrong current password)

item.name: Profile (Web)
item.description:
User self-service profile endpoints. All three use the browser session (cookie + CSRF token) — they are not JSON API endpoints and do not use a Bearer token.

Requires an active browser session (session cookie) and a valid CSRF token in the `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header. Each endpoint returns a `302` redirect back to `/profile` on success with a `flash.success` message.

header.description: Required CSRF token. Obtain from the XSRF-TOKEN cookie set by any authenticated page load.

request.description: Updates the authenticated user's display name. Validation: required, string, max 255 characters. Returns `302` back to `/profile` with a `flash.success` session value of `"Display name updated."`.

response.name: 422 Validation Error

formdata.description: Image file (JPG, PNG, GIF). Max size: 2 MB.

request.description:
Uploads or replaces the authenticated user's profile picture. The file is stored on the `public` disk under `profile-pictures/` and the path is saved to `users.profile_picture`. Any previously uploaded picture is deleted. The public URL is exposed as `profile_picture_url` on the `auth.user` Inertia shared prop.

Validation: required, must be an image (jpg/png/gif/bmp/svg/webp), max 2048 KB (2 MB).

Returns `302` back to `/profile` with `flash.success = "Profile picture updated."`.

response.name: 422 Validation Error (not an image)

request.description:
Changes the authenticated user's password. Validation: `current_password` must match the user's existing password; `password` is required, confirmed, and must be at least 8 characters.

Returns `302` back to `/profile` with `flash.success = "Password updated."`.

response.name: 422 Validation Error (wrong current password)

item.name: Admin Dashboard (API)
item.description: Aggregated admin dashboard snapshot — same data powering the Inertia Admin/Index page, served as a single JSON response for mobile and external consumers.

request.description:
Returns the full admin dashboard snapshot in one request:

- `data` — stat counters: `total_users`, `active_users`, `pending_invitation_users`, `active_apps`, `active_tenants`, `active_sso_sessions`
- `health_summary` — tenant health counts: `total`, `healthy`, `warning`, `critical`, `maintenance`
- `recent_users` — latest 5 users ordered by `created_at` desc; each entry includes `id`, `name`, `email`, `is_active`
- `pending_users` — users with an unsent invitation (`invitation_token` set, `is_active` false)
- `unresolved_errors` — cross-tenant unresolved error log aggregate: `total`, `error`, `warning`, `critical`, `by_tenant[]`
- `report_queue` — pending/processing/failed report counts: `pending`, `processing`, `failed`, `by_tenant[]`
- `migration_compliance` — tenant migration state: `total`, `up_to_date`, `behind_count`, `available_migrations`, `behind[]`

Requires Sanctum Bearer token.

item.name: System Settings (API)
item.description:
Manage system-wide settings over the REST API using Sanctum Bearer token auth.

All settings are stored as a flat key-value store — sending only the keys you want to change is safe; omitted keys are left untouched.

The response envelope is always `{ "data": { ...all settings... }, "missing_required": [...] }`. `missing_required` lists the human-readable labels of required settings that have no value set (`email_driver`, `authentication_idle_time`, `storage_driver`).

request.description: Returns all system settings and a list of required settings that are not yet configured.

response.name: 200 OK
response.body:

item.name: Documents (API)

Each document now includes a `source` field indicating its origin: `upload` (user-uploaded via the portal), `report` (auto-created when a PDF or Excel report job completes), or `subscription` (generated by a scheduled report subscription).
